description: Massachusetts Transmission Lines is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Harvard Map Collection, U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of the Census. This datalayer is a polyline coverage displaying non-railroad transmission lines (pipelines, powerlines and other miscellaneous transmisison line-like features) throughout Massachusetts. The data here were originally produced by MassGIS. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: For educational, non-commercial use only. Although this data set has been developed by the Harvard Map Collection and its partners, no warranty expres. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
